Correct the table selection: PC4/PC5 currently map to PC4-5, so class-one/two rows requiring PC1-5 are missed; implement the exact supplied tableModel rows and thickness bands. Enforce that actual and required grades belong to the same steelStrengthCategory; rank comparison alone permits, for example, a normal-strength grade in a high-tensile case. Preserve the existing case, selector, plating, table-reference, unit, and rank-direction checks.
